source.source_text: Purpose: inspect supported package-manager manifests/locks and optional outdated metadata without install/update. Input: project_root:string, manager?:auto|npm|pnpm|yarn|pip|uv|poetry|brew, check_outdated?:boolean. Output: manager, dependencies/lock facts, safe outdated summary. Contract: L2 read_only; scope mac.package.read; target project_root; timeout 30000ms; cap 512KiB; registry-read network only when enabled; filesystem read_allowed_project; secret files denied. Phase 3 planned.
